description: The whole of graph.ttl and graph.nq for a two-node dataset, byte for byte — the case of graph-0015, which it supersedes, with the one change AGSC-06-18 as amended at rc.6 makes: the Bundle's `bundle.license_prose` is `CC0-1.0`, not the Content Use Terms identifier, so the publisher has not adopted the Content Use Terms and `schema:usageInfo` carries the prose licence in their place, on the Bundle node and on the item node. Every other byte is graph-0015's: the constant seven-line prefix block of AGSC-05-10, one blank line between subject blocks and one trailing LF, subjects and predicates in IRI code-point order, `schema:license` and `schema:usageInfo` as plain literals (AGSC-05-31 form (c)), and each N-Quads line a quad whose graph name is the Bundle IRI (AGSC-04-15).
note: added 2026-09-24 at rc.6 as the successor of graph-0015; expected values derived by hand from the rule text (the two usageInfo literals changed), not from a run of any engine
